influences.name: Sam James
influences.context: I actually just had this conversation with Sam James last night. He's a very accomplished blues musician and writer around here, and we were literally talking about how, no, there isn't a moment where you stop feeling like that [art kid].

influences.name: Rossini
influences.context: I think it was Rossini who rented a room and refused to get out of bed, choosing instead to write musical scores all day until he drifted off into sleep... I imagined Ryan working in a similar way, writing on average, one or two songs per day.

influences.name: Bruce Springsteen
influences.context: At times he sounds very like a young Bruce Springsteen. Many of the themes he uses have been explored on other albums to much greater effect.
